title: Migrate dvb_t2_awgn_campaign binary to gf2-sim pipeline
description:
## Goal

Migrate `crates/gf2-coding/src/bin/dvb_t2_awgn_campaign.rs` from
`SimulationRunner::run_with_decoder` to the new gf2-sim hybrid
pipeline. Preserve all existing CLI flags (`--decoder`,
`--demap`, `--calibrate*`, `--resume`, `--esn0-range`,
`--target-errors`, `--max-frames`, `--seed`, `--output-dir`);
wire `--gpu` to the new HIP-backed path.

## Context

Task under story `5d0a3fad` (DVB-T2 BICM application on
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). This task is the
downstream dep that `e4849f07` (in `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`)
will be wired to. Placeholder body — project-lead expands during
claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Campaign binary runs end-to-end via the gf2-sim
  pipeline; all existing CLI flags pass through; the byte-identity
  contract on `fer` / `frames` / `errors` / `mean_iters` is
  preserved.
- [hard] `parallelism-pays` gate: smoke campaign for r1/2 16qam
  at the existing PLAN.md bracket completes with ≥100 errors at
  every bracket point in ≤ 24h wall-clock on AMD Ryzen 9 5900X.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
